companyFilesEmpty: 这个文件夹还没有资料
companyFilesEmptyHint: 有上传或创建权限时，可用右下角按钮添加资料，也可右键空白处或拖入文件。
Use the bottom-right actions, right-click empty space, or drop files here when you have permission.
권한이 있으면 오른쪽 아래 작업, 빈 공간 우클릭 또는 파일 끌어 놓기로 자료를 추가할 수 있습니다.
companyFilesTrashHint: 删除的资料会保留原件，授权人员可以还原。
Deleted documents retain their originals and can be restored by authorized staff.
companyFilesLockedHint: 独立访问范围仍然有效。解锁只在当前登录会话中临时生效。
Access rules still apply. Unlocking is temporary and limited to this session.
접근 규칙은 계속 적용됩니다. 잠금 해제는 현재 로그인 세션에서만 일시적으로 유효합니다.
companyFilesDeleteHint: 文件夹及其全部子项将一起移到回收站，原件保留。还原后仍按当前权限访问。
The folder and all its contents will move to the recycle bin. Originals are retained and current permissions apply after restoration.
companyFilesPasswordHint: 密码是当前资料的额外保护，不代替人员或部门授权。修改密码后，所有临时解锁失效。
The password adds protection to this item and does not replace access rules. Changing it invalidates temporary unlocks.
암호는 이 자료의 추가 보호 수단이며 접근 규칙을 대체하지 않습니다. 변경하면 임시 잠금 해제가 만료됩니다.
companyFilesPasswordMismatch: 两次输入的密码不一致
companyFilesAccessHint: 这些规则只适用于当前资料及其继承项，不会修改系统授权。拒绝规则优先；操作仍需已获授的使用资格。
These rules apply only to this item and inherited children; system grants are unchanged. Deny rules take priority and existing action permissions still apply.
이 규칙은 현재 자료와 상속 항목에만 적용되며 시스템 권한은 변경하지 않습니다. 거부 규칙과 기존 작업 권한이 적용됩니다.
companyFilesPrincipalSearch: Search a name, employee number or department
companyFilesQueueHint: 文件逐个上传并扫描。关闭队列不会删除已保存的资料。
Files are uploaded and scanned one at a time. Closing the queue keeps saved documents.
companyFilesTooLarge: 文件超过上传大小限制
companyFilesBatchTooLarge: 单次选择的文件总量不能超过 100 MB
Select no more than 100 MB at a time
companyFilesUnreadable: 无法读取文件，请重新选择
Unable to read the file; select it again
companyFilesDropHint: 松开鼠标，上传到当前文件夹
Drop to upload into this folder
companyFilesDragHint: 手动排序时可长按拖动位置；其他排序下拖到文件夹可移动。
In custom order, hold and drag to reorder; in other orders, drop onto a folder to move.
companyFilesPermissionDenied: 访问权限已变化，请刷新后重试
Access changed; refresh and try again
companyFilesUnknownHint: 请求可能已保存。请先核对结果，避免重复上传。
The request may have been saved. Check its result before uploading again.
companyFilesDuplicateRule: 此人员或部门的允许和拒绝规则已存在，请编辑已有规则。
Allow and deny rules already exist for this person or department; edit the existing rules.
companyFilesRuleActionsRequired: 请为每条规则至少选择一种操作。
Select at least one action for each rule.
companyFilesPreviewUnavailable: 此文件暂时不能在线预览，可以下载原件查看。
Online preview is unavailable. Download the original to view it.
companyFilesResumeName: 请选择与待完成文件同名的原件。
Select the original with the same name as the incomplete upload.
companyFilesKeepExtension: 重命名时请保留原扩展名，避免改变文件的打开方式。
Keep the original extension when renaming to preserve how the file opens.
